examples.arabic: اصحابي هيلعبوا العاب على تليفوناتهم بس جدتي عايزة تحكي قصص زمان
examples.english: My friends will play games on their phones, but my grandmother wants to tell old stories.
examples.transliteration: Ashabi hayel'abou al'ab ala telefoonat-hom bas gaddeti ayza tahki qesas zaman

examples.arabic: كان شكل حياته مختلف خالص عن ايامنا زمان هو بيكلم اولاده عن ألعاب جديدة
examples.english: His life looked completely different from our days back then; he was talking to his children about new games.
examples.transliteration: Kan shakl hayato mokhtalef khales 'an ayyamna zaman howwa beykallem awlado 'an al'ab gedeeda.

examples.arabic: اصحابها بيقولوا اهلا بيكي يا سارة ومبسوطين بالالعاب الجديدة
examples.english: Her friends say "Welcome to you, Sara" and are happy with the new games.
examples.transliteration: Ashaabha bi'oolo ahlan beeki ya Sara w mabsooteen bel-al'aab el-gedeeda.

examples.arabic: الشباب عايزين اتنين او تلاته اماكن جديدة فيها بحر او العاب
examples.english: The youth want two or three new places with a beach or games.
examples.transliteration: El shabab ayzeen etneen aw talata amaken gedida feeha bahr aw al'ab.

examples.arabic: انا بحب العب العاب على الموبايل
examples.english: I love to play games on my mobile.

examples.arabic: اخويا قاعد مع التليفون بتاعه بيلعب العاب
examples.english: My brother is sitting with his phone playing games.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya aa'ed ma' el-telefoon beta'o biyel'ab al'aab.
